_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. Collection (~68% CA, pilier dechets), Landfill (decharges, marge elevee), Environmental Solutions (croissance industrielle US Ecology), Total revenue.

kpis.signal: Pilier business ~68% CA, residentiel+small/large container, revenu recurrent contracts long terme
kpis.description_fr: Collecte residentielle + petit/grand containers commerciaux. ~68% du CA Republic. Revenu recurrent via contrats long terme.
kpis.description_en: Residential + small/large commercial container collection. ~68% of Republic revenue. Recurring revenue via long-term contracts.

kpis.signal: Decharges proprietaires (~12% CA), barriere entree forte (permis), marge brute elevee, RNG monetization
kpis.description_fr: Mise en decharge net intercompany. Actif strategique (~200 sites). Barriere reglementaire forte. Plus monetisation RNG (gaz renouvelable).
kpis.description_en: Net intercompany landfill. Strategic asset (~200 sites). Strong regulatory barrier. Plus RNG (renewable natural gas) monetization.

kpis.signal: Solutions dechets dangereux/industriels (US Ecology acquise mai 2022), repli FY25 (mix industriel)
kpis.description_fr: Dechets industriels/dangereux (US Ecology acquise mai 2022 pour 2.2 Mds). Saut 2022, repli FY25 lie au mix petrole/industriel.
kpis.description_en: Industrial/hazardous waste (US Ecology acquired May 2022 for $2.2B). 2022 jump, FY25 dip on oil/industrial mix.

kpis.signal: Saut 2022 lie a US Ecology, croissance ralentit FY25 (+3.5%) sur normalisation pricing
kpis.description_fr: CA consolide Republic Services. Saut 2022 par M&A US Ecology. Croissance plus modeste FY25 lie a normalisation yield (4.1% vs 5.1% FY24).
kpis.description_en: Republic Services consolidated revenue. 2022 jump from US Ecology M&A. Modest FY25 growth on yield normalization (4.1% vs 5.1% FY24).
